_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Diagram-Oriented Documentation System Configuration/Maintenance Program
summary: Specifies format and content preparation instructions for the DIODS Configuration/Maintenance Diagram Subsystem Manual, which presents maintenance and repair instructions and procedures pictorially.
use_relationship:
The Diagram-Oriented Documentation System (DIODS) Configuration/Maintenance Diagram (CMD) Subsystem Manual provides maintenance and repair instructions and procedures in a pictorial fashion as opposed to a narrative-type presentation.  Text is used sparingly to augment illustrations, diagrams, flowcharts, etc.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract, MIL-STD 38784(1), "Standard Practice for Manuals, Technical: General Style and Format Requirements" (entire document), and 3.1.5.2 of DS-83, "Data Standard for Preparation of DIODS Manuals."
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as cited in the current issue of the DODISS at the time of the solicitation and for non DODISS-listed documents (DS-83), as stated herein.  DS-83 (current edition) is available at National Security Agency, Acquisition Logistics and Deployment Review, 9800 Savage Rd, Suite 6129, Fort Meade, Md. 20755-6129, Attn: DA023.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The DIODS CMD subsystem manual shall be on 11 X 17 inch paper and conform to the format requirements stated in MIL-STD-38784(1).  Security classification markings shall be in accordance with MIL-STD-38784(1).

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The contents of the DIODS CMD Subsystem Manual shall be in accordance with 3.1.5.2 of DS-83.
